visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled dark hair and a white T-shirt stands before a neutral light background, holding a square pink makeup product box. He smiles warmly, pointing his index finger towards the 'wakemake' logo on the packaging while looking directly at the camera lens. (2) A close-up shot focuses on the man's hands as he flips open the clear plastic lid of the makeup palette, revealing six distinct rectangular pans of eyeshadow in shades of beige, rose pink, and deep brown. (3) The man holds a dual-ended makeup tool with a silver handle, featuring a white rounded sponge tip at one end and a small flat brush at the other, rotating it to show the textures. (4) The camera shows a close-up of the man's forearm where several streaks of pink and brown pigments are swatched to demonstrate color payoff against his light skin tone. (5) The man uses the small brush to apply a light beige shade to his left eyelid, looking into an off-camera mirror while blending the color upward toward his brow bone. (6) He switches to a darker rose-brown shade, applying it carefully to the outer corner of his eye and along the lower lash line to create depth and a gradient effect. (7) Using his right ring finger, he taps a shimmery, glittery light pink shade onto the center of his eyelid, followed by a close-up showing the reflective particles on his skin. (8) He utilizes the rounded sponge tip of the tool to apply a soft pink shade as blush on his high cheekbone, blending it with circular motions. (9) The man presents the finished eye makeup look, posing with a slight tilt of his head to showcase the shimmer and contour, then holds the palette and brush near his face with an enthusiastic expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a bright, energetic male voice speaking in Mandarin Chinese over a high-tempo, major-key electronic BGM featuring a steady synth bassline and crisp percussive claps. (2) A sharp, mid-frequency rustling sound occurs as the speaker handles the plastic product box, lasting for approximately two seconds while he continues his enthusiastic narration. (3) A distinct mechanical click SFX is heard as the palette lid is flipped open, followed immediately by a short 'ding' cartoon sound effect used for emphasis. (4) The speaker's vocal pitch rises during the swatching segment, accompanied by a soft rhythmic 'thumping' sound in the music that synchronizes with his hand gestures. (5) As the eye shadow application begins, the speaker adopts a more instructional but still animated tone, with rapid speech and frequent rising intonations to maintain viewer interest. (6) A high-pitched comic 'whoosh' or sparkle SFX is layered in as the shimmery eyeshadow is showcased, highlighting the visual change. (7) The BGM volume swells slightly during the final summary, where the speaker's intensity increases to a persuasive, authoritative delivery level for the call to action, concluding with a quick fade-out of the music.
